title: Create React MemoryPanel and HistorySearch components
description:
Create two React components: MemoryPanel.tsx and HistorySearch.tsx under react_ui/src/components/.

MemoryPanel.tsx — A memory review and control panel that:
- Lists a companion's memories with pagination
- Shows provenance metadata (source type, source turn, confidence) inline or on expand
- Displays privacy level badges (private/temporary/permanent)
- Provides inline actions: pin/unpin, edit, delete, set privacy, do-not-remember, remember-forever, correct
- Uses the memory API functions from client.ts (task b.8)

HistorySearch.tsx — A searchable conversation history browser that:
- Provides a search bar with date range picker and topic/tag filter
- Renders search results with snippet previews and pagination
- Links results back to conversation context
- Offers an export button that downloads filtered results as JSON or text
- Uses the memory API functions from client.ts (task b.8)

Follow the existing React patterns in the project (component structure, state management, Tailwind CSS, API call patterns).

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- react_ui/src/components/ for existing component patterns, imports, and styling conventions
- react_ui/src/api/client.ts for the memory API function signatures
- react_ui/src/types/ for existing type definitions

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
